d: iOS to PS Vita port of Skater Nation
ld: An unofficial native port of *Skater Nation* (Gameloft, iOS 1.2.1) to the PlayStation Vita.
req:
- Make sure your PS Vita has Henkaku / Enso installed with the following plugin active in ur0:tai/config.txt:
- libshacccg.suprx in ur0:data/ (Extract using ShaRKBR33D (https://github.com/OsirizX/ShaRKBR33D))
- Copy the contents of ux0_data/skaternation/ to ux0:data/skaternation/ on your PS Vita via FTP or USB.
- Game files: a decrypted Skater Nation 1.2.1 .ipa (FairPlay cryptid 0). Open it as a ZIP and extract
- > Game files are never distributed. You always need your own legally obtained copy of the game.
